content.what_it_is: MATLAB cohesive-vessel morphology plotter. It loads half-domain initial depth, constructs a mirrored 2n-1 by m domain and coordinates (L3-L15,L27-L35), loads frame 120 eta/mask/concentration/suspended-bed-change, mirrors each field, and plots concentration and bed change (L38-L90). It then cross-shore-averages the last bed-change field, takes rowwise elevation maxima/minima, plots those against the mirrored initial section, and writes a second JPEG (L91-L117).
entities: dep half-domain depth and DEP mirrored depth @L6,L32-L35
unresolved: Eta is masked to NaN before mirroring (L49,L53-L54), then rowwise `max`/`min` are called without `omitnan` at L97-L98. Any dry/masked cell in a row can make that row's extrema NaN rather than the wet-cell envelope, so the final red curves may disappear across rows containing shoreline masks.

The script is structured for multiple `nfile` values (L41-L89), but ETA/BEDS/BB are overwritten on every iteration and the section statistics L92-L111 use only the final frame. `mint` has three entries at L21 while active nfile has one and is never used, indicating an incompletely reduced multi-frame version.
Masking is applied to eta and concentration only (L49-L50), not `beds`; whether dry-cell DchgS values are valid is unstated. No shape checks precede mirroring assignments.
`BEDB` is allocated at L30 but never used; fixed axes are not derived from M,N,dx,dy.
